scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Unio--
I-Impossible! How c-can
something like this happen?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎来到炼金术士联——
不、不可能！怎、怎么会发生这种事？

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome, {0}.
The Alchemist Union
is busy today, like always.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎，{0}。
炼金术士公会今天也像往常一样忙碌。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Union.
We are recruiting
talented people
with novel ideas.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎来到炼金术士公会。
我们正在招募拥有新颖想法的有识之士。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Union.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎来到炼金术士公会。
有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Well now~!
You've brought an
Old Magic Book and
a Hammer of Blacksmith.
We'll put these items
to good use.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
哎呀~！
你带来了古魔法书和高级铁砧。
我们会好好利用这些物品的。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Seems like
you're all ready.
The Union will put
these items to good use.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
看来你已经准备好了。
公会会好好利用这些物品的。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Aren't you ready?
Like I said before,
you must bring
^551A8B{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
你还没准备好吗？
就像我之前说的，
你必须带来^551A8B{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Go and talk to
Mr. Raspuchin.
He's involved in the
Alchemist selection process, whatever that might mean.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
去和拉斯普钦先生谈谈吧。
他参与了炼金术士的选拔过程，不管那是什么意思。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Ah, I'm sorry, but
I'm busy right now~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
啊，抱歉，
我现在很忙~

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Wait, wait...
I'm sorry. I was confused,
that's all. You look just like
someone I used to know. 
Still, I get this weird
feeling about you...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
等等，等等……
对不起。我只是有点困惑，仅此而已。你长得太像我以前认识的某个人了。
不过，我对你有一种奇怪的感觉……

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Everyone is busy with their
own research, but recently, some headway has been made in the field of biotechnology.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
大家都在忙于各自的研究，但最近，在生命工学研究领域取得了一些进展。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Everyone is hoping that the biotechnological studies will yield positive results. Speaking of which, I wonder how the Alchemists working on artificial life are doing...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
大家都希望生命工学研究能取得积极成果。说到这个，我想知道那些研究人造生命的炼金术士们做得怎么样了……

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you're interested in working with chemistry, visit us later when you become more knowledgable.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果你对化学感兴趣，等你知识更丰富后再来找我们吧。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Just one thing:
You've got to have
knowledge of items
as a Merchant first.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
只有一点：
你首先必须作为商人具备物品知识。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you know any exceptional Merchants, by all means, please refer them to us. Those types of people tend to have a talent for Alchemy and experimentation~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果你认识任何出色的商人，请务必将他们推荐给我们。这类人往往在炼金术和实验方面很有天赋~

scripts.text: I would like to learn about Alchemists.
scripts.translation: 我想了解关于炼金术士的事。

scripts.text: I want to become an Alchemist.
scripts.translation: 我想成为炼金术士。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Alchemists study and create new substances and items out of existing materials. Our knowledge allows us to change the properties of chemicals at the atomic level.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
炼金术士研究并利用现有材料创造新的物质和物品。我们的知识使我们能够在原子层面改变化学物质的性质。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Most people think our final goal
is to create gold, but that's not the entire truth. We also want to create things like medicines
and new materials.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
大多数人认为我们的最终目标是制造黄金，但这并非全部真相。我们也想制造药品和新材料等物品。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
A few of us research the
creation of life, although many of us consider that god's territory. That field is so complex, most of us deal with slightly less complicated projects anyway.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
我们中有少数人研究生命的创造，尽管许多人认为那是神的领域。那个领域太复杂了，所以我们大多数人还是处理稍微简单一点的项目。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you are interested in becoming an Alchemist, I recommend that you first get a lot of experience as a Merchant. Being a Merchant is a great opportunity to learn about materials as you deal with them.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果你有兴趣成为炼金术士，我建议你先积累丰富的商人经验。作为商人，在处理材料时是了解它们的绝佳机会。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Whether or not you try to become
an Alchemist is your decision. The road to becoming an Alchemist is very challenging, and you'll need to focus on experimentation and research, instead of commerce.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
是否尝试成为炼金术士是你的决定。成为炼金术士的道路充满挑战，你需要专注于实验和研究，而不是商业。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Is that so?
Nice to meet you.
My name is Parmy Gianino
of the Alchemist Union.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
是吗？
很高兴见到你。
我是炼金术士公会的帕米·吉亚尼诺。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you join our Union and
complete the training, you
will be officially recognized
as an Alchemist and be able
to contribute to our research.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果你加入我们的公会并完成训练，你将被正式认可为炼金术士，并能为我们的研究做出贡献。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But we don't accept everyone.
You must have a lot of tenacity
and sincere devotion in exploring
the various fields of science.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
但我们不是来者不拒。
你必须在探索各种科学领域时具备极大的毅力和真诚的奉献精神。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
There are a couple
of requirements to join
the Alchemist Union, but
we'll discuss that
after you apply.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
加入炼金术士公会有几个要求，但我们将在你申请后再讨论。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Well then, would
you like to apply
for registration?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
那么，
你想申请
注册吗？

scripts.text: I would like to apply.
scripts.translation: 我想申请。

scripts.text: I'll do it later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再做。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Hmmm...
Just a moment.
I'm sorry to say that
you're not experienced
enough as a Merchant to
join us right now.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
嗯……
请稍等。
很遗憾地说，
你目前的商人经验
还不足以加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
You must be at least
^551A8BJob Level 40^000000 to become
an Alchemist. Come back
later when you meet the
Job Level requirement, okay?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
你必须达到至少^551A8B职业等级40^000000才能成为炼金术士。等你满足职业等级要求后再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Alright, your application has been accepted. Now, you must pay the 50,000 Zeny application fee and bring some items before you can begin your formal training.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
好的，你的申请已被接受。现在，你必须支付50,000泽尼的申请费，并带来一些物品，然后才能开始正式训练。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But if you bring an ^551A8BOld Magic Book^000000 and ^551A8BHammer of Blacksmith^000000,
we will accept that as a substitute for the item requirement.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
但如果你带来^551A8B古魔法书^000000和^551A8B高级铁砧^000000，
我们将接受这些作为物品要求的替代品。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Now...
Please sign
the application.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
现在……
请签署
申请表。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Good, good. Now, if you have
the Zeny for your application fee ready, I will tell you which items you will need to bring. Now, pay attention.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
很好，很好。现在，如果你准备好了申请费的泽尼，我会告诉你需要带来哪些物品。请注意听。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Uh oh. You don't
seem to have enough Zeny.
Come back to me when you have 50,000 Zeny, otherwise we can't process your application.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
哎呀。你似乎
没有足够的泽尼。
等你有了50,000泽尼后再来找我，否则我们无法处理你的申请。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}
需要带来……

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B7 Berserk Potions^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}
需要带来……
^551A8B7瓶菠色克药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B100 Mini Furnaces^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}
需要带来……
^551A8B100个携带用熔矿炉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B7,500 Fire Arrows^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}
需要带来……
^551A8B7,500支火箭矢^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Once you've gathered
those items, come back
to me and your training
as an Alchemist will begin.
See you soon~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
一旦你收集到
这些物品，就回来
找我，你的炼金术士
训练就将开始。
回头见~

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Talented Merchants
are always welcome here.
Please come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
这里随时欢迎
有才华的商人。
请尽快回来。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Umm...
Please let me know
if you need anything.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
嗯……
如果需要什么，
请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Okay, now you need to learn
the basics to being an Alchemist and learn the procedures for mixing chemicals and medicines.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
好的，现在你需要学习
作为炼金术士的基础知识，并学习混合化学品和药品的程序。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But before all of that, you need to speak to Raspuchin. I'm not really sure what you'll be talking about with him...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
但在这一切之前，你需要和拉斯普钦谈谈。我不太确定你会和他谈些什么……

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
It shouldn't be anything extraordinary, but you're still required to speak to Raspuchin, since apparently he's a part of the Alchemist selection process.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
应该不是什么特别的事，但你仍然需要和拉斯普钦谈谈，因为显然他是炼金术士选拔过程的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Okay, now you need to learn
the basics to being an Alchemist and learn the procedures for mixing chemicals and medicines.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
好的，现在你需要学习
作为炼金术士的基础知识，并学习混合化学品和药品的程序。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But before all of that, you need to speak to Raspuchin. I'm not really sure what you'll be talking about with him...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
但在这一切之前，你需要和拉斯普钦谈谈。我不太确定你会和他谈些什么……

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
It shouldn't be anything extraordinary, but you're still required to speak to Raspuchin, since apparently he's a part of the Alchemist selection process.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
应该不是什么特别的事，但你仍然需要和拉斯普钦谈谈，因为显然他是炼金术士选拔过程的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Come back when you
have prepared the
required items.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
当你准备好
所需物品后
再回来。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Hopefully, it
won't be too much of
a problem. I guess he'll just interview you, and ask you
some simple questions.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
希望这
不会造成太大
麻烦。我想他只会
面试你，并问一些
简单的问题。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Why don't you ask
someone else if you're
not sure who to visit
next? Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果你不确定
接下来该拜访谁，
不妨问问其他人？
祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
Eh? What do you want?!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻
呵呵呵~！
呃？你想要什么？！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
How cute, you've come
all this way just to play...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻
呵呵呵~！
真可爱，你大老远跑来只是为了玩……

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What is it?!
You're curious as
to what I'm doing?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么事？！
你好奇我在
做什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
What do you
want, kid?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻
呵呵呵~！
你想要什么，
小孩？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What...?!
You want to take
the test again?!
I thought I told
you to leave!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么……？！
你想再参加一次
测试？！
我以为我叫你
离开了！

scripts.text: [Raspuchin Gregory]
scripts.translation: [拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What are you doing?
Go and find Darwin now.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你在做什么？
现在去找达尔文。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Keheheheheheheheh~
Don't think this is the end of it!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
呵呵呵呵呵呵呵~
别以为这就结束了！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You're not here to steal my experimental results or plagiarize my work, are you? How dare you consider intellectual theft!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你不是来偷我的实验结果或抄袭我的作品的，对吧？你怎么敢考虑智力盗窃！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You're not, are you?
Well, as a colleague,
let me just warn you
that such tricks aren't
tolerated here in the
Alchemist Union!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你不是，对吧？
好吧，作为同事，
让我警告你，
这种伎俩在
炼金术士公会是不被容忍的！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
I'll let you
go this time...
But next time, don't
expect to leave so easily...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
这次我就放你
一马……
但下次，别指望
这么容易离开……

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heehee
keheheh~!
Why, I'm busy
researching,
of course!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻
呵呵呵~！
为什么，我当然在忙着
做研究！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Once this
potion is complete...
You can use it to take
over an entire nation!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
一旦这瓶
药水完成……
你可以用它来接管
整个国家！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Hee hee hee!
Something this
dangerous has to
be kept a secret!
Understand?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘿嘿嘿！
像这样危险的东西
必须保密！
明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
A Merchant should go and set up shop and vend items. Why are you wandering in a place like this?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
商人应该去开店贩卖物品。你为什么在这种地方游荡？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heheheh~!
Go vend somwhere else!
And leave me to my
dark enterprise!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
呵呵呵~！
去别处贩卖吧！
让我专心搞我的
黑暗事业！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What...?
Learn Alchemy?!
Don't even speak
such nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么……？
学习炼金术？！
别说这种胡话！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Even if you tried studying for a thousand years, maybe even more, it'd be useless to you! Forget about it and just worry about your store!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
即使你学习一千年，甚至更久，对你也没用！忘掉它，只管担心你的店铺吧！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What...?
Join the Union!?
I don't like it...
I just don't...!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么……？
加入公会！？
我不喜欢……
我就是不喜欢……！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Nowadays, anyone thinks they can
be Alchemists just by knowing how to mix a few herbs. That's why my interview is necessary.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
如今，任何人都认为只要知道如何混合几种草药就能成为炼金术士。这就是为什么我的面试是必要的。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
I plan on weeding out all the dumb and incompetent, and chase them
all away! We don't need morons!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻
呵呵呵~！
我打算淘汰所有愚蠢和无能的人，把他们全都赶走！我们不需要笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Wait...
Maybe I've
misjudged you.
You might be a pretty boy,
but I can tell you're smart
from your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
等等……
也许我
看错你了。
你可能是个漂亮男孩，
但从你的眼神中我能看出你很聪明。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Wait...
Maybe I've
misjudged you.
Huh. You're a cutie alright,
but I can tell you've got brains.
scripts.translation:

Ooh...

You got them all correct!?
Keheheh, I have no choice but to acknowledge you...
scripts.translation:

哦……
太好了！棒极了！
你全都答对了！？
呵呵呵，我不得不承认你……

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You got one wrong!
But I'll let it slide.
You pass the interview!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你答错了一个！
但我会放过你。
你通过面试了！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You've got serious
weaknesses in math,
but I'll let you go this time...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你的数学能力有很严重的弱点，
但这次我就放过你……

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh! Idiot!
Just listening to your
answers is making me feel
stupider! You might as well
have got them all wrong!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
呵呵呵！笨蛋！
光听你的回答就让我觉得变蠢了！你还不如全答错呢！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
How can a person that
can't even answer all of
these simple questions think
of becoming an Alchemist?!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
一个连这些简单问题都答不上来的人，怎么能想成为炼金术士？！

Did you get
any right?
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Ah...
You...
You've become
an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊……
你……
你已经成为
一名炼金术士了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
When you have
your dreams, you
have everything.
Without them, you have
nothing more to lose.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
当你拥有梦想时，你就拥有一切。
没有它们，你就没有什么可失去的了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...

[Darwin]
I said to go
to Van Helmont.
I'd like to teach you
more, but I can't.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我叫你去
找范·赫尔蒙特。
我想教你更多，但我不能。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I have already given you all of my knowledge and have nothing more
to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我已经把我所有的知识都给了你，没有什么可教的了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Remember...
In your quest
to make your
dreams come true,
do not lose what
you cherish.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
记住……
在追求实现梦想的途中，
不要失去你所珍视的东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Ah...
Harmona...
My love...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊……
哈莫娜……
我的爱人……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
These cursed eyes...
They've lost sight of
my dreams a long time ago.
Ha ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
这双受诅咒的眼睛……
它们很久以前就看不见我的梦想了。
哈哈哈……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Does paradise
really exist...?
Not without my love...
Not without Harmona...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
天堂真的存在吗……？
没有我的爱人……
没有哈莫娜……就不存在……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...
......
Who is it...?

[Darwin]
A wolf?
Or a human?
You must be seeking
something, are you not?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是狼？
还是人类？
你一定在寻找什么，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
After all...
Everyone has desires
to fulfill. Be be careful.
Do not be like the wild
wolf drawn to the flowers.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
毕竟……
每个人都有欲望要满足。但要小心。
不要像被花朵吸引的野狼一样。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
In your efforts to gain something else, you may end up sacrificing something precious to you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
在努力获得其他东西的过程中，你可能会牺牲对你来说珍贵的东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Cultivating joy and happiness
is much like cultivating flowers.
If something is missing, the
flower will wilt away...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
培养快乐和幸福就像培育花朵。
如果缺少了什么，花朵就会枯萎……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
What brings you
to this kind of place?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是什么带你来到这种地方？

scripts.text: I want to learn how to experiment.
scripts.translation: 我想学习如何做实验。

scripts.text: Tell me more about flowers.
scripts.translation: 告诉我更多关于花朵的事。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
You wish to
learn Alchemy?
Everything I know,
I've learned for the
sake of making my
dream come true...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你想学习炼金术吗？
我所知道的一切，都是为了实现我的梦想而学的……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I'll teach
you the basics...
But everything you
learn afterwards must
be directed through
your own motivations.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我会教你基础知识……
但你之后学到的一切都必须是出于你自己的动机。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I will teach you
how to make simple
medicine. So please
bring the following
materials right away.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我会教你如何制作简单的药品。所以请立刻带来以下材料。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
^551A8B3 Medicine Bowls^000000,
^551A8B3 Empty Bottles^000000,
^551A8B1 Red Herb^000000,
^551A8B1 Yellow Herb^000000 and
^551A8B1 White Herb^000000.

[Darwin]
Once you have
prepared everything,
return to me.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
一旦你准备好了一切，就回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Flowers...?
In the darkest
recesses of my mind,
there is a blossum
that I faintly remember...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
花朵……？
在我脑海的最深处，有一朵我依稀记得的花……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
For the one that
I love, I put all
of my efforts into
researching that one thing.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
为了我爱的人，我全力以赴地研究那一件事。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I won't tell you the details,
but I was basically researching
the relationship between
wolves and flowers.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我不会告诉你细节，但我基本上是在研究狼和花之间的关系。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
But yes...
It was a flower.
With its shine, it was said
to let you see paradise.
The ^551A8BIllusion Flower^000000...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是的……那是一朵花。
据说它的光芒能让你看到天堂。
^551A8B幻想花^000000……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I even made
a Homunculus,
but no one believed that I could create new life from a flower...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我甚至制造了一个生命体，但没有人相信我能从一朵花中创造出新生命……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Then...
Well, some other things happened, and now I have nothing left. Time no longer has any meaning for me.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
然后……
嗯，发生了一些其他事情，现在我一无所有。时间对我来说已没有任何意义。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Ahh...
Harmona...
Where have you gone?
I hope you're in a field
of beautiful flowers...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊……
哈莫娜……
你去了哪里？
希望你在一片美丽的花海中……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Consider what
is most precious
to you. It cannot
be protected if you
do not recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
想想对你来说最珍贵的东西。如果你不认识它，就无法保护它。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...
......
Who is it...?

[Darwin]
Ah...
You are the one who
wishes to learn Alchemy.
Have you prepared everything?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊……
你就是那个想学习炼金术的人。
你准备好一切了吗？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Wait.
That Illusion Flower.
How did you get that?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
等等。
那朵幻想花。
你是怎么得到它的？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Where did you find it?!
The flower that slowly
blooms under the
moonlight?
It's beautiful...!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你在哪里找到它的？！
那朵在月光下缓缓绽放的花？
真美……！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Th-That flower...
Please let me see it.
The Illusion Flower!
Uwaaaaaaah!!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
那、那朵花……
请让我看看。
幻想花！
哇啊啊啊啊！！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Would you be so kind
as to let me have this flower?
I'm sure that this is the Moonlight Flower that I've been seeking!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你能好心把这朵花给我吗？
我确信这就是我一直在寻找的月夜猫！

scripts.text: Sorry, I can't give it to you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不能给你。

scripts.text: I brought it to give to you.
scripts.translation: 我带来它是为了给你的。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I understand.
You can't give
such a precious
flower to just anyone.
Well... It's okay.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我明白。
你不能把如此珍贵的花随便给任何人。
好吧……没关系。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
It just brought back old memories. I shouldn't have asked in the first place. In any case, please bring what is needed for the experiment.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
这只是勾起了旧时的回忆。我本不该问的。总之，请带来实验所需的东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Please leave that flower
somewhere else. It brings
back too many memories...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
请把那朵花放在别处。它勾起了太多的回忆……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Are you
serious?!
Thank you!
Such a precious flower.
Ah, Harmona, my love...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你是认真的吗？！
谢谢！
如此珍贵的花。
啊，哈莫娜，我的爱人……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Yes...
I shall repay you for this.
I shall plant all of my knowledge of Alchemy directly into your mind...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是的……
我将以此回报你。
我将把我所有的炼金术知识直接植入你的脑海中……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Open your eyes wide,
and look into my eyes!!
Don't stop until the end!!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
睁大眼睛，
看着我的眼睛！！
直到最后都不要停下！！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
^666666*Gasp...*^000000
You are now
an Alchemist!!
Go to the Union
and cast away the last
vestiges of Merchant life!!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
^666666*喘息*^000000
你现在是一名炼金术士了！！
去公会，
抛弃商人生活的最后残余！！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Seems like you have everything ready. As promised, I will teach you how to make simple medicine.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
看来你已经准备好了一切。如我所承诺的，我将教你如何制作简单的药品。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
First, prepare the Medicine Bowl. Then, you put the Herbs inside, like this, and slowly crush them.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
首先，准备好药钵。然后，像这样把药草放进去，慢慢捣碎它们。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Pour small amounts
of clean water and stir
the mixture until it thickens.
Afterwards, add some more Herbs.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
倒入少量的清水，搅拌混合物直到变稠。之后，再加入一些药草。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
That's how you make it. If you think you have enough, gently pour the mixture into an empty bottle.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
就是这样制作的。如果你觉得足够了，轻轻地将混合物倒入空瓶中。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
There you go,
it's complete.
Now, make some medicine
using the simple procedure
I just explained to you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
好了，
完成了。
现在，用我刚才解释的简单程序制作一些药品。

scripts.text: Prepare the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 准备药钵。

scripts.text: Put the Medicine Bowl on your head.
scripts.translation: 把药钵戴在头上。

scripts.text: Kick the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 踢药钵。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
What...?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
什么……？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
No!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
不！

scripts.text: Put some dirt in the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 在药钵里放些泥土。

scripts.text: Put some Herbs in the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 在药钵里放些药草。

scripts.text: Put a Harp in the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 在药钵里放一把竖琴。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...Eh!?
That's not
medicine!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
……咦！？
那不是药品！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
A Harp?
And how would
you do that?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
竖琴？
你要怎么做？

scripts.text: Crush the Herbs.
scripts.translation: 捣碎药草。

scripts.text: Crush the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 捣碎药钵。

scripts.text: Crush Darwin's foot.
scripts.translation: 踩达尔文的脚。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Wh-What are
you doing!?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你、你在做什么！？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Agh...!
What do you
think you're
doing?!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊……！
你以为你在做什么？！

scripts.text: Spray clean water.
scripts.translation: 喷洒清水。

scripts.text: Drink clean water.
scripts.translation: 喝清水。

scripts.text: Pour clean water.
scripts.translation: 倒清水。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Huh?
What are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
哈？
你在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
W-wait...
Are you
taking a break?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
等、等等……
你在休息吗？

scripts.text: Continue crushing the Herbs.
scripts.translation: 继续捣碎药草。

scripts.text: Continue eating the Herbs.
scripts.translation: 继续吃药草。

scripts.text: Continue dancing and singing.
scripts.translation: 继续跳舞唱歌。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Eat the Herbs?
I think you need
to focus on the
task at hand...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
吃药草？
我觉得你需要专注于手头的任务……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Singing and
dancing? Alchemists
don't do that, have
you gone crazy?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
唱歌跳舞？炼金术士不做那种事，你疯了吗？

scripts.text: Put noodles in and fry it.
scripts.translation: 放入面条并油炸。

scripts.text: Pour it in an empty bottle.
scripts.translation: 倒入空瓶。

scripts.text: Hold the Medicine Bowl and drink it.
scripts.translation: 拿着药钵喝掉。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
We're Alchemists,
not restaurant chefs.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我们是炼金术士，不是餐厅厨师。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Huh...
Pretty sloppy...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
哈……
相当马虎……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
You messed up the mixture
since you didn't follow the procedure! Get some more ingredients so you can try it
again until you get it right.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你没有按照程序操作，弄乱了混合物！再去拿些原料，直到你做对为止。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Good job.
It came out pretty well considering it's your first time. Go ahead and keep the medicines that you've just made.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
干得好。
考虑到这是你第一次，做得相当不错。收下你刚做好的药品吧。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Now, go into the next room
and speak to Van Helmont to
continue your training.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
现在，进入下一个房间，和范·赫尔蒙特交谈以继续你的训练。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Never forget...
You must always protect
what is most precious to you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
永远不要忘记……
你必须始终保护对你来说最珍贵的东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Have you forgotten
what you need to bring?
Let me remind you once
again. You must come
back with...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你忘了需要带什么吗？
让我再提醒你一次。你必须带着……回来。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
^551A8B3 Medicine Bowls^000000,
^551A8B3 Empty Bottle^000000,
^551A8B1 Red Herb^000000,
^551A8B1 Yellow Herb^000000 and
^551A8B1 White Herb^000000.

[Darwin]
Come back
when you are
ready...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
等你准备好后再回来……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Aah...
Harmona, my love.
I can't even see the flower anymore. My soul quietly
withers as well..
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊……
哈莫娜，我的爱人。
我甚至再也看不见那朵花了。我的灵魂也在静静地枯萎……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Go to the second floor and talk to speak to our Union Leader. Once
you do that, your life as an Alchemist will begin.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
去二楼和我们的公会首领谈谈。一旦你那样做了，你的炼金术士生涯就将开始。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
These cursed eyes...
They've lost sight of
my dreams a long time ago.
Ha ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
这双受诅咒的眼睛……
它们很久以前就看不见我的梦想了。
哈哈哈……

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Does paradise
really exist...?
Not without my love...
Not without Harmona...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
天堂真的存在吗……？
没有我的爱人……
没有哈莫娜……就不存在……

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What do you want?
I'm busy!! Don't
bother me and get
on your way.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你想要什么？
我很忙！！别打扰我，走开。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Just a little...
A little bit more...
Nooo! Just a little
bit more and it
would've been done!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
就差一点……
再差一点点……
不！再差一点点就完成了！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Arrrrgh...!
Why isn't this formula working? What's wrong? In theory, it's all correct, but there must be an error in the formula somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
啊啊啊……！
为什么这个公式不起作用？哪里出错了？理论上都是正确的，但公式中肯定有错误……

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Alright, if I make an incision here in the Tentacle, and add a Jellopy and Sticky Mucus solution into the... Where the hell did my Medicine Bowl go?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好吧，如果我在这里切开触手，并将杰勒比结晶和粘稠液体溶液加入……我的药钵去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What...?
I thought I told you to
talk to Nicholas next door?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
什么……？
我不是叫你和隔壁的尼古拉谈谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Now, come on...
You'll never get
any research completed if you just slack off. Go out and learn all that you can.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
来吧……
如果你只是偷懒，你永远无法完成任何研究。出去尽可能多地学习。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Reading science journals and performing experiments. That's what Alchemy is all about. Now, let me get back to work!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
阅读科学期刊并进行实验。这就是炼金术的全部。现在，让我回去工作！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Why...?!
Why, another failure?!
My calculations were
all correct! W-Wait...!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
为什么……？！
为什么又失败了？！
我的计算都是正确的！等、等等……！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Perhaps, if I capacitated the thermal flux by using the neutronic gradient, it just might work...!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
也许，如果我利用中子梯度使热通量电容化，它可能会起作用……！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
I pour it in here, and it should stop. Wait, this is the wrong solution! How could I make such
a dumb mistake?! When did these
get switched?!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
我倒进去，它应该停止。等等，这是错误的溶液！我怎么会犯这么愚蠢的错误？！它们什么时候被调换了？！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Okay, okay...
I just need to fix this part.
No need to start over. I just
need to fix it... But wait. Wait...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好的，好的……
我只需要修复这部分。
不需要重新开始。我只需要修复它……但是等等。等等……

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Um...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯……
你是谁？

scripts.text: I want to become an Alchemist.
scripts.translation: 我想成为炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Hmm...?
What, did you just want to watch? Fine, fine, but do it quietly and leave right when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯……？
什么，你只是想看看？好吧，好吧，但请安静地看，看完后立即离开。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Stay out of my way and don't go around touching stuff. There might be some volatile materials, so it'd be dangerous to have any accidents.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
别挡我的路，也不要乱碰东西。可能有一些挥发性材料，发生事故会很危险。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
You...?
An Alchemist?
What a funny Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你……？
炼金术士？
真是个有趣的商人。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Well, that's nice, but I have very urgent experiments that require
my attention, so don't get
in the way.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好吧，那很好，但我有非常紧急的实验需要我关注，所以别挡路。

scripts.text: Teach me something.
scripts.translation: 教我点什么。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Argh...!
Didn't I just tell you not to bother me? What's so hard to understand about that?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
啊……！
我不是刚告诉过你别打扰我吗？这有什么难理解的？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Fine, fine. I'll give you an assignment. Learn something
new and come back. Let's see.
What would be good...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好吧，好吧。我给你布置一个任务。学点新东西再回来。让我看看。
什么比较好……

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Okay, I got it.
Go learn how to make
a Counteragent and Mixture
from Molgenstein.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好的，我知道了。
去向莫尔根斯坦学习如何制作解毒剂和混合物。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
You don't need to bring anything. Just go watch him at work and have him tell you how he makes those solutions. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你不需要带任何东西。只要去看他工作，让他告诉你他是如何制作那些溶液的。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Well then, see you later.
You'd better get going as
soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
那么，回头见。
你最好尽快出发。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
......

[Van Helmont]
...
......

[Van Helmont]
So if I recalibrate the combustion rate of this compound, that should negate any cohesive tendencies in this particle flux...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
所以如果我重新校准这种化合物的燃烧率，那应该能抵消粒子通量中的任何凝聚倾向……

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
But what am I going to do
about all of this spontaneous
crystallization?! I can't very well remove this matrix, I need it for the catalyst to reach the triple point.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
但我该怎么处理所有这些自发结晶呢？！我不能移除这个矩阵，我需要它让催化剂达到三相点。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Damn!
What am
I going to do?!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
该死！
我该怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Did I use them all at a time like this?! I wonder if Nicholas has any left. Ugh, what a pain. Wait. Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
我在这种时候把它们都用完了吗？！不知道尼古拉还有没有剩的。唉，真麻烦。等等。等一下……

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
......
Who are you?
I want to become an Alchemist?
scripts.translation: 我想成为炼金术士？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Hmm...?
What, did you just want to watch? Fine, fine, but do it quietly and leave right when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯……？
什么，你只是想看看？好吧，好吧，但请安静地看，看完后立即离开。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Stay out of my way and don't go around touching stuff. There might be some volatile materials, so it'd be dangerous to have any accidents.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
别挡我的路，也不要乱碰东西。可能有一些挥发性材料，发生事故会很危险。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Ah, of course. The Merchant from before. So what did you learn from Molgenstein? I didn't just send you there for fun, you know.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
啊，当然。之前的那个商人。那么你从莫尔根斯坦那里学到了什么？我送你过去可不是为了好玩。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Let me ask you
some questions to
check what you've
learned.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
让我问你一些问题，检查一下你学到了什么。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Which item is not
necessary to make
a Counteragent?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作解毒剂不需要哪种物品？

scripts.text: Karvodailnirol
scripts.translation: 卡勒波迪药水

scripts.text: Detrimindexta
scripts.translation: 帝特立米药水

scripts.text: Alcohol
scripts.translation: 酒精

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What item is not
necessary to make
a Mixture?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作混合物不需要哪种物品？

scripts.text: Karvodailnirol
scripts.translation: 卡勒波迪药水

scripts.text: Detrimindexta
scripts.translation: 帝特立米药水

scripts.text: Alcohol
scripts.translation: 酒精

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Weren't you listening to Molgenstein at all? Maybe you
have to watch him make it again.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你根本没听莫尔根斯坦说话吗？也许你得再看他做一次。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
If you can't tell the exact items that you need in an experiment,
you might end up hurting yourself!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
如果你分不清实验中需要的确切物品，你可能会伤到自己！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Good, you've learned well.
Okay, now you know something about experimentation. You're done here, so now I can continue with my experiments.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
很好，你学得不错。
好的，现在你对实验有了一些了解。你在这里的任务完成了，所以我可以继续我的实验了。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Go out and find the room next
to this one and talk to Nicholas. He'll continue your training.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
出去找到旁边的房间，和尼古拉谈谈。他将继续你的训练。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What are you
still doing here?
Go! We both have
more important
things to do!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你还在这里做什么？
走！我们都有更重要的事情要做！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What item do
you need to make
a Counteragent?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作解毒剂需要哪种物品？

scripts.text: Feather
scripts.translation: 羽毛

scripts.text: Sticky Mucus
scripts.translation: 粘稠液体

scripts.text: Animal Gore
scripts.translation: 家畜血

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What item do
you need to make
a Mixture?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作混合物需要哪种物品？

scripts.text: Monster Feed
scripts.translation: 魔物饲料

scripts.text: Ancient Lips
scripts.translation: 人鱼嘴巴

scripts.text: Rotten Bandage
scripts.translation: 腐烂绷带

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Be honest. You don't know, do you?! Didn't I say to go to Molgenstein and have him teach you?!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
老实说。你不知道，对吧？！我不是叫你去莫尔根斯坦那里让他教你吗？！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Don't even think about coming back until you talk to him! Now stop bothering me and get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
在你和他谈话之前，别想回来！现在别打扰我，滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
I need to continue my research,
and you need to finish becoming an Alchemist. Come on, get moving!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
我需要继续我的研究，你需要完成成为炼金术士的过程。来吧，动起来！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Why...?!
Why, another failure?!
My calculations were
all correct! Wait...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
为什么……？！
为什么又失败了？！
我的计算都是正确的！等等……

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Perhaps, if I capacitated the thermal flux by using the neutronic gradient, it just might work...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
也许，如果我利用中子梯度使热通量电容化，它可能会起作用……

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
You have transcended...
Excellent, excellent.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
你已经超越了……
很好，很好。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Welcome!
So how is your
research coming along?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
欢迎！
那么你的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hm...
A Novice?
You shouldn't be
playing in a place
like this.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯……
初心者？
你不应该在
这种地方玩耍。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hmm...?
What's an adventurer
doing here in the
Alchemist Union?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯……？
冒险者在
炼金术士公会做什么？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hmm...?
A Merchant?
Are you interested
in learning Alchemy?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯……？
商人？
你有兴趣学习炼金术吗？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hmm...you don't seem to be qualified yet.
Remember, you must reach at least job level 40 to become an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯……你似乎还不够资格。
记住，你必须达到至少职业等级40才能成为炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Ah, you're almost
ready to become an
Alchemist, but you must
first allocate your unused
Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
啊，你差不多准备好成为炼金术士了，但你必须先分配未使用的技能点数。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Ah, well done.
I can see that you
have learned all of
the basics of Alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
啊，做得好。
我看出你已经学会了炼金术的所有基础知识。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Ah...
I believe you've
already registered
for training to become
an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
啊……
我相信你已经注册了成为炼金术士的训练。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
You don't belong here.
Go and explore the wide world, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
你不属于这里。
去探索广阔的世界吧，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
At times you get results that are unexpected from an experiment. Although these may be setbacks in your research, such results can also lead to new discoveries.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
有时你会从实验中得到意想不到的结果。虽然这些可能是你研究的挫折，但这样的结果也可能导致新的发现。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
If you discover something new,
come and tell us. Don't forget that we are all working together to unlock the mysteries of science!
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
如果你发现了新事物，来告诉我们。别忘了我们都在共同努力解开科学的奥秘！

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
There are a lot of volatile chemicals and dangerous
materials in this building. It'd be a lot better if you just played outside.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
这栋楼里有很多挥发性化学品和危险材料。如果你只是在外面玩会更好。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
I'm afraid there's
not much we can offer
you here if you're not
a member of our Union.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
恐怕如果你不是我们公会的成员，我们这里没什么能提供给你的。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
This is the Alchemist Union.
We research and experiment with many different substances in order to create new materials without using magic.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
这里是炼金术士公会。
我们研究和实验许多不同的物质，以便在不使用魔法的情况下创造新材料。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Someday, we hope to unlock
the secret of life, as well as the other mysteries of science.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
总有一天，我们希望解开生命的秘密，以及科学的其他奥秘。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
After being traveling as a Merchant for a long time, you must have developed some scientific curiosity. If you'd like to learn Alchemy, why don't you try joining the Alchemist Union?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
作为商人行走了很长时间后，你一定产生了一些科学好奇心。如果你想学习炼金术，为什么不试试加入炼金术士公会呢？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Talk to me again
once you have spent
all of your extra
Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
等你花完所有额外的技能点数后再和我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Henceforth, you are
now a member of our
illustrious Union.
I hope you learn a lot...
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
从此以后，你就是我们杰出公会的一员了。
希望你学到很多……

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Let me give you
something special.
You can use this to
begin your life
of research.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
让我给你一些特别的东西。
你可以用它来开始你的研究生涯。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
And...
Here's a little
something to help
you begin your
research.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
还有……
这里有一点小礼物，帮助你开始研究。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
I'll see
you later then...
Remember to carry
yourself with pride
as an Alchemist!
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
那么回头见……
记住要以炼金术士的身份自豪地行事！

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Please listen to the
other Alchemists and follow their instructions carefully. You will learn much from them.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
请倾听其他炼金术士的意见，并仔细遵循他们的指示。你会从他们那里学到很多。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back again -
- after you store some items into kafra storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 目前你携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请将一些物品存入 -
- 卡普拉仓库后再回来。 -

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ooh...
You're the upstart
Merchant that wants
to become an Alchemist?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
哦……
你就是那个想成为炼金术士的新手商人？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Not just anyone can become an Alchemist, you know. You've got to have motivation and clear goals and a strong sense of focus.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
不是任何人都能成为炼金术士的，你知道的。你必须有动力、明确的目标和强烈的专注感。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Alchemists must memorize many chemical equations, scientific laws and a lot of other information. It's actually pretty tough.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
炼金术士必须记住许多化学方程式、科学定律和大量其他信息。这其实相当困难。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
If you can't focus, you'll be confused later when you look at Alchemy charts. My test will judge your ability to do just that.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
如果你不能集中注意力，以后看炼金术图表时会感到困惑。我的测试将判断你在这方面的能力。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Find the words scrambled
in the group of letters I give you. They can be made by using some
or all of the letters.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
在我给你的一组字母中找出打乱的单词。它们可以使用部分或全部字母组成。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
You pass if you
choose the word
that is ^551A8BIN^000000 the puzzle.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
如果你选择谜题中^551A8B包含^000000的单词，你就通过了。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ah, you finished.
Now, let's see...
Excellent job!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
啊，你完成了。
现在，让我看看……
干得漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ah, you finished.
Now, let's see...
^666666*Gasp!*^000000 H-horrible!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
啊，你完成了。
现在，让我看看……
^666666*倒吸一口凉气*^000000 太、太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Great, you found all of those hidden words. With that kind of concentration, you should have no problem memorizing information.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
太好了，你找到了所有隐藏的单词。拥有那样的专注力，你应该在记忆信息方面没有问题。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Come back in a little bit while
I prepare the next assignment
for your training.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
等我为你准备下一个训练任务时，稍后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Oh, and before you talk to
me again, make sure you have
^551A8Bplenty of room in your inventory^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
哦，在再次和我谈话之前，确保你的^551A8B背包有足够的空间^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Judging from these results, you obviously have a problem with concentrating.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
从这些结果来看，你显然在集中注意力方面有问题。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
If you can't even solve these easy word puzzles, how can you keep track of your experiments and research?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
如果你连这些简单的字谜都解不开，你怎么能跟踪你的实验和研究？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Why don't you relax
and rest a bit before
you take the test again?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
你为什么不在再次参加考试前放松休息一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Whoa...
You're carrying too much stuff! First, put some of your things in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
哇……
你带的东西太多了！首先，把你的一些东西放进卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Alright...
For your next
assignment, you'll
need to travel to ^551A8BJuno^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
好吧……
对于你的下一个任务，你需要前往^551A8B朱诺^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
There, you'll need to talk to ^551A8BBain^000000 and ^551A8BBajin^000000. Those two are doing Alchemy research with the Sages
in Juno. You'll learn something by assisting them with their project.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
在那里，你需要和^551A8B贝恩^000000和^551A8B巴金^000000谈谈。那两个人正在朱诺和贤者们一起进行炼金术研究。通过协助他们的项目，你会学到一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Come back here to me after you
help them out. They'll need all of these items to continue their experiments.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
帮助他们之后回到我这里。他们需要所有这些物品来继续他们的实验。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
1 Mixture,
5 Burnt Tree,
5 Fine Sand,
3 Rough Oridecon
and 3 Rough Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
1个混合物、
5个燃烧一半的木材、
5个黄晶沙、
3个神之金属原石
和3个铝原石。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Alright.
Have a safe trip
and come back in
one piece.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
好吧。
旅途平安，
完好无损地回来。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Didn't I say to
go to Juno and help
Bain and Bajin with
their Alchemy research?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
我不是叫你去朱诺帮助贝恩和巴金进行他们的炼金术研究吗？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ah, you're back!
I just got a message from Bain
and Bajin. They let me know that they were very happy with your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
啊，你回来了！
我刚收到贝恩和巴金的消息。他们告诉我他们对你的帮助非常满意。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
If you were good enough
to help out those brothers,
you definitely qualify to be
an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
如果你足够优秀能帮助那两兄弟，
你绝对有资格成为炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Good work!
All you have to do now is speak to the Union Leader on the 2nd floor! Congratulations, you'll become an Alchemist very soon!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
干得好！
你现在所要做的就是和二楼的公会首领谈谈！恭喜你，你很快就会成为炼金术士！
